item.title: Scholar and Zenodo Pipeline Validation Post
item.description:
Summary

This temporary post validates the combined Genomics x AI Google Scholar metadata and Zenodo DOI pipeline on a feature branch.

This is an operational test article for the Genomics x AI publishing workflow.

It confirms that a newly accepted post can move through the manual test-publish workflow, receive Zenodo DOI metadata in the sandbox, build a preview page, and render Google Scholar-compatible citation metadata that includes the DOI.

This post should be removed from the branch before merge.

item.title: Welcome to the Genomics × AI Blog
item.description:
Welcome to the Genomics × AI blog.

We created this space for the community to use to share short, opinionated blog posts about how genomics and machine learning actually get done in real labs: what works, what doesn’t, and the ideas we’re still testing. Posts will be written in Git, reviewed internally within your lab, editorially reviewed in public, and published only when an editor is happy with them—so every article has a clear history and a clear home.

Note: This is to disseminate ideas, incremental results, negative results and tutorials quickly using blog posts as a more personalised, free-form format.

If you’d like to contribute, start by reading the Submission Guidelines and opening a discussion with us on GitHub Discussions.
